text:
noah: running the quickstart (python) with a service account. first call throws an SDK error: `AuthError: 403` but body says payment_required. quickstart didn't warn about invite/workspace billing.

noah: code: ```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['RW_KEY'])
print(client.generate('rwd-small','hey'))
```

noah: raw response printed: `{'status': 403, 'code': 'forbidden', 'message': 'workspace_billing_required'}`

devex_bot: hi @noah. quick checks: is the SA token scoped to the same org as the workspace? did you join via invite or SSO? invite orgs sometimes need billing handshake to provision trial credits.

noah: joined with an invite link from the team (org: org-blue-17). SA was created by me earlier using the console in my personal org. hmm.

jen_ops: that would explain it. tokens created in personal org won't lift billing gate on the invited workspace. you need to create the SA inside org-blue-17 or regenerate the token after swapping org context.

noah: i can't access the console yet (SSO sticky). i *did* add a card to the workspace earlier. still getting 403.

billing-bot: note: if billing was accepted recently, tenant cache may not have refreshed. to force: `@billing-bot refresh org-blue-17` or call `POST /internal/workspaces/org-blue-17/refresh` (maint token required). propagation ~30s-2m.

noah: ran `@billing-bot refresh org-blue-17`. also created a new SA inside org-blue-17 and updated RW_KEY in env. retried after ~1m and now SDK error shows `402 payment_required` with body `{'error':'payment_required','message':'credits_pending'}`. weird that it moved from 403->402.

devex_bot: proxy layers can differ: edge may return 403 when tenant mapping missing; billing service returns 402 when credits not ready. both indicate billing handoff incomplete. regeneration + refresh usually resolves.

noah: FYI my CI pipeline still failing after I updated the secret. the container logs show old env var.

jen_ops: common CI issue: secret rotation doesn't update running runners. restart the job or new runner, or print env inside container to confirm.

noah: printed env from inside container and it was the old key. recreated the job with new secret, ran quickstart again.

billing-bot: tenant refresh complete for org-blue-17. cache TTL cleared.

noah: success! `200 OK` and generated text returned. first successful call. :tada:

devex_bot: great. follow-ups: 1) docs: add an "invite flow" note in quickstart w/ step-by-step (add card -> refresh -> regenerate SA in org), 2) SDK: surface raw error body on non-2xx as `responseBody` to help disambiguate 403 vs 402, 3) Console: consider a banner for invite-only orgs that shows billing handshake status + refresh button.

jen_ops: adding doc todo and SDK issue. thanks for the debug trail and for calling out CI env caching.

noah: thanks everyone, closing this thread. :thumbsup:
